name: live-aggressive
set_by: Grayson, Nov 2, 2026: real money, big trades, start with $20-25. These are his money rules for the live account; the crew and the lab never change them.
note: Used only when the repo variable ALPACA_LIVE is 1 (real-money endpoint, live key pair). All-in: one position at a time with the whole cash balance, 3x ETFs, opening-range-breakout entry, 3R target with the same breakeven/trail exits the paper bot runs, flat by 2:45 PM CT (no overnight holds: a fractional stop order only lives for the day). Hard stops: equity at or below the $5 floor = flatten and lock; a $5 loss on the day = flatten and done. Past-day evidence (factory/trading/lab/live-aggressive-2026-11-02.json) shows this profile LOSING on the last 60 trading days; it is a hypothesis, not an edge. The account can lose all of it. Not financial advice. Review fixes (Nov 2, 2026): a flatten counts only once Alpaca's positions read back empty; on early-close days the flat time is 15 minutes before the close; a broken copy of this file stops the bot instead of falling back to the paper rules.
universe_note: Leveraged ETFs (3x index, 2x single-stock). Each name is checked once a day against Alpaca /assets and dropped unless active, tradable and fractionable. The crew's daily avoid list (earnings, halts, gaps, the FOMC hour) still applies.
account_pin_note: The account pin is the repo VARIABLE ALPACA_LIVE_ACCOUNT_ID only (the account number Alpaca's dashboard shows, or the API account id): never paste an account id into this public file. The first live heartbeat shows the last 4 characters of the account number so you can check which account is trading.
